title: Siren Over Toxic City
description: A cosmic purple silhouette of a female figure with glowing yellow earrings dances on turbulent turquoise waves in the foreground. Behind her, a sprawling cyberpunk industrial city billows thick black smoke under an orange sky, with multiple flying saucers hovering above and a neon-lit shack on the rocky shore.
prompt: A glowing purple cosmic female silhouette with starry skin and yellow earrings dances gracefully on crashing turquoise waves in the foreground. In the background, a massive polluted industrial cyberpunk city with glowing neon signs emits thick black smoke into an orange apocalyptic sky. Several flying saucers hover above the smokestacks, with a small illuminated shack on the rocky coast, surreal dark fantasy atmosphere.
